## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented solution.

## Validation

List the exact tests, builds, and manual checks performed.

## Documentation and API

Describe documentation, translation, migration, and API-contract effects.

## Security and Data Impact

Describe authorization, CSRF, uploads, storage, backups, restore, or data-loss implications. Write
`None` when the change has no such impact.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, including relevant light, dark, desktop,
or mobile states.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the relevant Go tests and/or frontend tests and build.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the API contract where required.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, runtime data, generated builds, or private backups.
- [ ] I license my contribution under AGPL-3.0-only and have the rights to submit it.
